_meta.description: Every question about Enter Space answered, including the full list of supported cloud providers, serve types and sync types.
a-heartfelt-thank-you.6098ec: A heartfelt thank you to the many early supporters who purchased Enter Space before this pricing change. You believed in the app early on, and that means the world to me. As a token of gratitude, all existing purchasers enjoy Grandfathered access — you will continue to have full, unrestricted access to Enter Space without ever needing to subscribe or make an additional purchase. Your original purchase is honored, no strings attached.
absolutely-enter-space-offers.202494: Absolutely! Enter Space offers a free 7-day trial with full access to every feature — no restrictions. This gives you plenty of time to connect your cloud accounts, set up syncs, and see how Enter Space fits into your workflow before deciding on a plan.
all-your-cloud-storage.ac8483: All Your Cloud Storage, One Place
apple-tvs-typically-live.dfe906: Apple TVs typically live in shared spaces, so by default any remote you've marked hidden stays hidden on every TV. When someone taps "Show Hidden Remotes" on a TV, an unlock request is sent to your iPhone or Mac and a push notification appears with Approve and Deny actions — even if the app is force-quit. Tap Approve, authenticate with Face ID / Touch ID, and hidden remotes appear on that one TV for the next 3 hours.
backup-directories-optionally-config.dd5: Backup directories — Optionally configure a backup directory so that files replaced or deleted during a sync are preserved rather than permanently lost.
bisync-two-way-sync.cf8a09: Bisync — Two-way sync that keeps both source and destination in sync with each other, propagating changes in both directions.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
can-i-perform-file.b26009: Can I perform file operations within the app?
can-i-try-enter.93729b: Can I try Enter Space before committing?
copy-copies-new-and.4d30d7: Copy — Copies new and changed files from source to destination without deleting anything at the destination.
duplicate-tasks-quickly-duplicate.f81a76: Duplicate tasks — Quickly duplicate an existing scheduled sync task to set up a backup to an additional location. All settings, filters, and options are copied so you can reuse your existing configuration without starting from scratch.
each-apple-tv-is.0b99b4: Each Apple TV is paired by name. The first time you unlock a TV you're asked to confirm the name it claimed for itself, which then locks on the TV — so another device on your iCloud account can't register a TV with the same name to trick you into approving the wrong one. Confirmed TVs show up cleanly in the unlock list; unconfirmed ones are flagged with an "Unconfirmed" pill.
each-scheduled-sync-task.701273: Each scheduled sync task can be configured with a range of options:
edit-only-providers-configure.867ac3: Edit-only providers (configure via rclone.conf; not shown in the in-app Add Remote picker because of vendor sandbox/auth quirks, but fully editable and usable once present):
enter-space-also-keeps.989b7a: Enter Space also keeps detailed logs from the last 50 scheduled sync executions, so you can review exactly what happened during each run — including files transferred, errors encountered, and overall sync statistics.
enter-space-is-a.3bcc75: Enter Space is a paid app — the entire app requires an active subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase to use. There is no free tier or partially unlocked mode. After your 7-day free trial, you can choose the plan that works best for you:
enter-space-is-designed.23f2f5: Enter Space is designed so that recovering from a lost or broken Mac is as painless as possible. Most of your Enter Space settings are automatically saved to your iCloud account, and sensitive credentials like remote access tokens and passwords are securely stored in your iCloud Keychain.
enter-space-offers-several.172ef6: Enter Space offers several types of automated sync operations to keep your data backed up:
enter-space-provides-the.6bb9d2: Enter Space provides the client, but beyond that it is up to you to use cloud storage providers you trust. Your credentials are stored locally in your device's Keychain (and synced via iCloud Keychain if enabled), and your files travel directly between your device and your chosen provider — never through us.
enter-space-supports-all.145cb0: Enter Space supports all of Rclone's well-supported cloud storage providers:
enter-space-uses-apple.2ae262: Enter Space uses Apple's File Provider framework to integrate directly with the Files app on iOS and Finder on macOS. Your cloud storage appears as a location in Files/Finder, allowing you to access files with any app that supports file browsing.
filtering-include-or-exclude.58e5c0: Filtering — Include or exclude files using path wildcard patterns, modification timestamps, or file sizes. Filters can be applied in an inclusive or exclusive manner, giving you precise control over exactly which files are synced.
how-do-i-recover.52f36e: How do I recover my setup on a new or replacement Mac?
how-does-enter-space.ac2e67: How does Enter Space handle my privacy?
how-does-the-apple.85450d: How does the Apple TV hidden-remotes unlock work?
how-does-the-files.102e68: How does the Files app integration work?
icloud-file-materialization-when.7c7312: iCloud file materialization — When syncing iCloud Drive directories, Enter Space will automatically materialize (download) evicted files before the sync runs and re-evict them afterward. This lets you back up your full iCloud Documents even if the files aren't actively present on your device.
if-you-run-into.07a3b1: If you run into any issues during your trial (or at any point after subscribing), please don't hesitate to reach out to me. I'm happy to help troubleshoot and resolve any problems. Fixing issues for you makes the app better for everyone.
is-enter-space-available.0f95d6: Is Enter Space available in the European Union?
is-my-data-secure.cb1d55: Is my data secure with end-to-end encryption?
move-moves-files-from.c56c62: Move — Moves files from source to destination, removing them from the source after a successful transfer.
network-awareness-automatically-skip.6fb: Network awareness — Automatically skip syncs when on battery power, low-data networks
on-a-mac-enter.a7f175: On a Mac, Enter Space can also mount a remote as a real volume through a file-system extension, without the helper — Finder and Terminal both see it, and switching the remote on or off updates the volume in place.
on-macos-webdav-ftp.770c50: On macOS, WebDAV, FTP, and NFS serves can be automatically mounted into your filesystem with the Mount Helper App, giving you an alternative way to browse and manage your cloud files alongside the standard File Provider integration. NFS in particular is dramatically faster than WebDAV for media playback over encrypted cloud remotes because macOS's NFS client doesn't probe every file the way Finder's WebDAV client does — and NFS mounts land under ~/Library/Application Support/Enter Space/Mounts/ instead of /Volumes/ so Spotlight doesn't try to index your entire cloud tree.
photos-backup-automatically-backs.0ce9f7: Photos Backup — Automatically backs up media from your Photos library. Choose to export photos, videos, or both, and optionally preserve metadata via sidecar files. You can export the original unedited version, the edited version, or both. Only new or changed media items are exported, so subsequent runs are fast and incremental.
plus-rclone-wrapper-types.1e73b2: Plus Rclone wrapper types for advanced workflows:
pricing-is-subject-to.3248b6: Pricing is subject to change as features and market conditions evolve. All plans — including subscriptions and the lifetime purchase — support Apple Family Sharing, so one purchase can cover your entire family.
rate-limit-tuning-set.b645af: Rate-limit tuning — Set a transactions-per-second cap and low-level retry count to stay within a provider's limits (great for backends like pCloud with dynamic, unpredictable throttling). If a destination keeps rate-limiting, the sync detects the repeated limit and aborts cleanly with a clear message instead of hammering away.
rclone-is-a-battle.194a88: Rclone is a battle-tested open-source command-line tool for managing cloud storage. It's been around for years with a proven track record of reliability and security. Enter Space is built on Rclone, giving you the power of this trusted tool with a beautiful native Apple interface.
remote-configurations-your-configure.3bd: Remote configurations — Your configured cloud storage remotes and their connection settings.
schedule-options-set-syncs.cec558: Schedule options — Set syncs to run on custom intervals, or use near-realtime file monitoring to sync moments after changes are detected. They can even be triggered from Apple Shortcuts
scheduled-sync-tasks-all.5fc3d9: Scheduled sync tasks — All of your automated sync configurations, schedules, and filtering rules.
secrets-and-credentials-access.6f7d83: Secrets and credentials — Access tokens, passwords, and API keys are stored in iCloud Keychain for end-to-end encrypted sync across your devices.
serve-configurations-any-file.41d228: Serve configurations — Any file serving setups you've created (e.g., WebDAV, SFTP, HTTP servers).
sync-makes-the-destination.3eb83c: Sync — Makes the destination match the source, copying new and changed files and deleting files from the destination that are no longer in the source.
tap-lock-from-the.4ad63e: Tap Lock from the phone or Mac and the TV snaps back to the locked home grid immediately — within seconds — even if someone was mid-playback on hidden content. The lock signal rides Apple's CloudKit infrastructure (no server we operate), with an iCloud-key-value fallback that catches it within a couple of seconds if the push gets delayed.
the-current-introductory-pricing.c5d41c: The current introductory pricing is available for a limited time, and no additional sales are planned after this period. Pricing is subject to change as features and market conditions evolve. All plans — including subscriptions and the lifetime purchase — support Apple Family Sharing, so one purchase can cover your entire family.
the-following-are-persisted.ed33b4: The following are persisted to your iCloud account and will be available on your new device:
the-serve-feature-lets.1e9dfa: The Serve feature lets you spin up a local server that exposes any of your configured remotes using a variety of Rclone serve types — including WebDAV, NFS, FTP, SFTP, HTTP, S3, DLNA, and Restic. This is useful for accessing your cloud files through other apps or devices on your network.
us-prices-shown-the.000d77: US prices shown; the App Store shows yours. See plans and prices

what-is-rclone-and.19e99a: What is Rclone and why is it important?
what-types-of-automated.e82dc4: What types of automated syncs are available?
when-you-sign-into.3ed033: When you sign into your iCloud account on a new Mac and install Enter Space, your previous settings will be securely restored — in most cases automatically. This means you can get back to a fully working backup setup without manually re-entering credentials or recreating your sync tasks from scratch.
which-cloud-storage-providers.8aad23: Which cloud storage providers are supported?
while-enter-space-can.fddc5a: While Enter Space can connect to over 100 cloud storage providers, the app runs entirely on your device. It connects directly from the app to your configured providers — Enter Space does not monitor, track, or even route your data through any intermediary servers. This means Enter Space has zero insight into how you use the app or what data you store, ensuring the utmost privacy.
yes-enter-space-can.68ee9d: Yes! Enter Space can use Rclone's Crypt remote wrapper, which is built on XChaCha20-Poly1305 — an encryption algorithm that is highly efficient and that some researchers have attributed as being theoretically post-quantum resilient. When using a remote wrapped in the crypt type your files are encrypted entirely on your device before they're uploaded to the cloud, meaning only you can decrypt and access your data — even if the cloud provider or someone else gains access to your cloud account.
yes-enter-space-includes.7a89f3: Yes! Enter Space includes basic file operations like copy, move, delete, rename, and create folders directly within the app. You can also use these operations through the Files app integration.
yes-enter-space-is.1dfac2: Yes. Enter Space is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
